OSCAL metaschema (vendored subset)
=================================

This folder contains a small, vendored subset of the OSCAL POA&M JSON Schema
needed for BOBBIE's local validation. It is intentionally simplified: only the
fields BOBBIE currently emits/consumes are required.

Source: upstream OSCAL repository (usnistgov/OSCAL). This vendored copy is not
an authoritative full OSCAL metaschema; it's a pinned, minimal schema for
offline validation in CI. To update, replace the files and record the upstream
commit or tag here.

Pinned: vendored on 2026-02-25
Upstream: https://github.com/usnistgov/OSCAL
